cmd: xtcp2-nl-ipmon c0 "monitor prefix maddress" "xtcp2-nl-ra r0p fe80::2 2001:db8:5::/64 0 0" "prefix 2001:db8:5::/64dev r0 valid 600 preferred 0"
desc: corner: the deprecated prefix, preferred lifetime zero
pre: n=$(ip netns identify $$) && ip netns set "$n" 0 && ip link add c0 type dummy && ip link set c0 up && ip link add r0 type veth peer name r0p && ip link set r0 addrgenmode none && ip link set r0p addrgenmode none && sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.r0.accept_ra=2 && sysctl -wq net.ipv6.conf.r0.accept_ra_from_local=1 && ip link set r0p up && ip link set r0 up && ip -6 addr add fe80::2/64 dev r0p nodad
